claims.answer: Maestro is an opt-in lead agent with approved recruits; shipped squads define role presets and their connections. The product-owned Maestro CLI recruits and briefs peers after approval, wires them together and inspects progress. This is product integration around installed CLIs. ask hands a prompt to another agent; check reads output without interrupting, and no-wait supports asynchronous handoff. An ask can wait for the peer response; later follow-up uses ask and progress uses check. No completion retention guarantee beyond the documented session behavior is inferred.

sources.title: Catenary readme
sources.locator: Install table; What is inside; local/remote path
sources.finding: Documents desktop packages for macOS, Windows and Linux, local PTYs, worktree tasks and optional SSH/WSL execution. This public repository distributes releases rather than application source.

sources.title: Catenary terminals
sources.locator: Agents are just CLIs; Talking to peers
sources.finding: Documents direct claude and codex terminal launch, existing native CLI authentication, session resume and list/ask/check peer communication.

sources.title: Catenary maestro
sources.locator: The commands; The workflow; Helper limits
sources.finding: Maestro is off until human-enabled. Its recruit operation creates agents after approval, objectives become initial prompts, ask gives follow-up instructions and check reads progress. Free permits2 helpers; Pro defaults to10, configurable.

sources.title: Catenary worktrees
sources.locator: What one click does; Finishing a task; Limits
sources.finding: New Task creates branch/worktree/terminal from HEAD; tasks run side by side. Branch menu has Review Diffs, Create pull request and discard. Free supports2 parallel tasks.

sources.title: Catenary editor
sources.locator: Reading what an agent changed; When an agent edits the same file
sources.finding: Documentation displays an actual refresh-function diff replacing fetch with a withRetry call, alongside the description of Monaco side-by-side branch changes. Unsaved-buffer conflicts expose View diff, Reload, Keep mine and Keep both. This is a vendor illustration, not an executed app observation.

sources.title: Catenary privacy
sources.finding: Policy describes no ADE telemetry, disabled analytics endpoint and removed Sentry DSN, plus separate update checks and license activation. Binary code was not accessible for verification.

sources.title: Catenary terms
sources.finding: Integrated application is proprietary software with restricted redistribution and modification; third-party component licenses are separate.

sources.title: Catenary site
sources.locator: Pricing section: Free and Pro; Privacy outbound traffic
sources.finding: Free has no time limit, one open project and2 parallel tasks. Pro costs US$19 once for1.x on up to2 personal computers. No Catenary account is required; users supply model access.
